title: charger
description: v0.1 device-model entity: a non-solar battery charger, regardless of vendor: an AC mains charger, or a DC-DC charger fed by the vehicle alternator or another DC source. Published under renewvan/charger/<id>/<property>. Solar controllers are the separate `solar` entity. Only `voltage_v` is required of every source; everything else is optional.

driver.description: Optional, retained. The key of the Driver publishing this instance: the <driver> segment of renewvan/<driver>/info, published as renewvan/charger/<id>/driver. Same slug rule as driver-info.schema.json. Identity field. A consumer must tolerate it being absent (a Driver that predates it) and then attributes the instance to every Driver whose info `publishes` lists 'charger'.

name.description: Optional, retained. Human-readable label of this instance (e.g. 'House battery'), published as renewvan/charger/<id>/name. Identity field.

voltage_v.description: Voltage on the charger's battery (output) side.

current_a.description: Optional: current delivered to the battery. Positive = into the battery; negative = drawn from it, as during an `emergency_charge`.

power_w.description: Optional: output power delivered to the battery, in watts. Same sign as `current_a`: negative while the charger draws from its output battery (`emergency_charge`).

input_voltage_v.description: Optional: voltage on the charger's input side (alternator/starter battery for a DC-DC charger, mains for an AC charger).

input_voltage_alarm.description: Optional, alternator (DC-DC) chargers only: the starter-battery alarm on `input_voltage_v`, decided by the publishing driver (not by clients). `low` once the input voltage has stayed below the driver's threshold for its hold time (driver-vedirect: 12.4 V for 120 s, set in its `[starter]` config); `ok` otherwise. Retained and live: cleared with the other live values when the device goes silent.

source.description: Optional: what feeds the charger. `unknown` is the forward-compat fallback.

charge_state.description: Optional: the charger's own charge stage. `unknown` is the forward-compat fallback for any code not in this enum. `emergency_charge` is a DC-DC charger running backwards for a few minutes (Victron Orion XS firmware >= 1.15, VE.Direct CS 243): it charges its input (starter) battery from its output (house) battery, so `current_a` and `power_w` are negative.
